description: List recently sent emails from your Wraps email history, newest first, at most `limit` messages. The timestamp shown is the send time and is stable across calls. Returns send status, subject, recipient, timestamp, and messageId for each send. Use the messageId with get_email_event_log for full delivery details. The `since` parameter accepts a full ISO 8601 datetime string (e.g., 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z).

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return, newest first (default 20).

since.description: Only messages with activity at or after this ISO 8601 datetime.

name: list_recent_sends

hasMore.description: True when more sends exist beyond this page.

messageId.description: Use with get_email_event_log for full delivery detail.

sentAt.description: ISO 8601 send time; stable across calls.
